interface.longDescription: AegisVita - Brand Builder OS helps founders and operators shape a research-informed business and brand strategy, from an early idea through customer discovery and offer feasibility. It then helps turn that strategy into content and customer-journey plans. Workflows include market research, personal or business branding, content creation, lead-generation planning, customer experience, and measurement. The OS challenges assumptions, separates evidence from hypotheses and examples, and flags unsupported or contradicted figures. Research and image creation depend on host tools. It provides planning support, not legal, tax, accounting, financial, regulatory, or specialist operational advice.
interface.defaultPrompt: I have a business idea and don't know where to start. Guide me one question at a time.
